name: Bark
title: Bark

description.zh-Hant: Bark 自託管通知推播服務
description.zh: Bark 自托管通知推送服务

notes: Keep application version 2.4.0; this is a packaging correction, not an upstream upgrade.
Docker Hub index verified: sha256:f3fa583422f9e870cec2c619d714946f549fbf7fd2c822da4a4ef43893ed3159; linux/amd64, linux/arm64, linux/arm/v7.
Official Alpine runtime has no USER override; retain default runtime user and entrypoint. No host chown hook is required.
No automatic migration from legacy BARK_ROOT_PATH: stop the old application and copy its /data contents to the new installation data directory.
App-specific translations use English fallback outside Chinese; common Port labels reuse the skill translations.
Basic Auth deliberately excludes paths starting with /ping, /register, /healthz in upstream v2.4.0; missing/invalid credentials return HTTP 418.
DSN blank selects Bbolt. External MySQL is optional and not bundled. No need for host initialization or uninstall hooks.

zh.introduction: 是 Bark iOS 客户端的自托管推送服务端，可通过 HTTP 接口向自己的 iPhone 发送自定义通知。

features.title: 自定义推送
features.description: 支持通过 HTTP GET、POST 和 JSON 请求发送通知。

features.title: 数据存储
features.description: 默认使用本地 Bbolt 数据库，也支持连接外部 MySQL。

features.title: 访问认证
features.description: 支持可选的 HTTP Basic Auth；上游允许健康检查和设备注册接口免认证访问。

en.introduction: is the self-hosted push server for the Bark iOS app. Send custom notifications to your iPhone through HTTP requests.

features.title: Custom notifications
features.description: Send notifications using HTTP GET, POST, or JSON requests.

features.title: Storage
features.description: Uses local Bbolt storage by default, with optional external MySQL support.

features.title: Authentication
features.description: Supports optional HTTP Basic Auth; upstream exempts health checks and device registration from authentication.
